description.public:
Nobody admits to brewing it and nobody asks where it comes from. A swig of this murky violet tonic and the voices quiet down, the shadows stop moving, and for a while it really will be alright.

The mind remembers the relief, though. Each dose leaves you a little more Addicted, and an addicted mind needs a stronger dose to feel anything at all.
description.private:
GM notes: the addiction cycle

The module handles all of this when the GM confirms the cards. These notes are for running it at the table.

Each dose

  1. The dose clears Madness at the hero’s current addiction level: its strength less the tolerance penalty, never below 0.

  2. Then the dose adds its addiction: Shoddy +1, Standard +2, Fine +3, Superior +4, Masterwork +5. The Addicted (N) effect on the sheet shows the level.

Rests

  • A dose can only be taken straight after the hero’s Rest, one per Rest, never in combat.

  • A Rest lowers addiction by 1 only if the hero took no dose since their last Rest. A night on the stuff holds the level.

  • The Shakes: a hero who wakes from a clean Rest while addicted has 1 bane on attacks, spells and checks for 4 hours of game time. Any dose ends it at once. That is the temptation: dose and feel fine, or shake for half a day.

Insanity

  • An Insane hero cannot Rest, so they may take a dose at any time out of combat. It is the one thing that brings them back, and it is meant to be nasty.

  • A dose that ends Insanity leaves Fragile Calm: their next Rest restores no Madness, so the cure buys no free recovery.

  • If Madness fills up again before that Rest, the calm shatters: the hero is Insane again, addiction rises by 1, and a chat card says so. The next dose meets worse tolerance, so they need stronger stuff.

How it plays

  • Standard every night clears 5, then 2, then nothing, with addiction at 2, 4, 6, 8.

  • One Masterwork clears 40 but leaves addiction 5; a second the next night clears up to 25 and leaves 10. Getting clean from 10 takes 11 nights: the first Rest after a dose only holds the level.

  • Shoddy is the safe cheap option: 1 Madness, and it stops working at once if the hero is already addicted.

Running it

  • Sell it where nobody asks questions: a back-alley dealer, a crooked apothecary, a desperate camp follower. Not the temple.

  • To clear a hero’s addiction, delete their Addicted effect. To set a level, run game.modules.get("pauls-foundry-module").api.setAddiction(actor, level); api.getAddiction(actor) reads it.

  • Undoing a dose or Rest card in chat undoes its Madness change and Fragile Calm, but not the addiction level or The Shakes. Fix the level with setAddiction, and delete The Shakes effect by hand.

actions.name: Take a Dose
actions.description:
Take the @ref[item.name] straight after a Rest, or give it to an adjacent ally. An @Condition[insane] hero cannot Rest, but may take a dose at any time out of combat, and it is the one thing that brings them back. A dose that ends Insanity leaves them in a Fragile Calm: their next Rest restores no Madness. If their Madness fills up again before that Rest, the calm shatters and their addiction rises by 1. The target recovers @Rule[resource.madness]{Madness} by the quality of the dose, less a penalty for how Addicted they already are. Then the dose adds to their addiction.

  • Shoddy - Recover 1 Madness. Addiction +1.

  • Standard - Recover 5 Madness. Addiction +2.

  • Fine - Recover 10 Madness. Addiction +3.

  • Superior - Recover 20 Madness. Addiction +4.

  • Masterwork - Recover 40 Madness. Addiction +5.

Tolerance. Each level of addiction weakens a dose by more than the last: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36 Madness at levels 1 to 8.

Getting clean. A Rest lowers addiction by 1, but only if you took no dose since your last Rest. You wake from that Rest with The Shakes: 1 bane on attacks, spells and checks for 4 hours. Any dose ends The Shakes at once.
